notes.title: X-Blades Digital Deluxe Content and Soundtrack available
notes.content:
today we released the Digital Deluxe Content which contains:

- Strategy Guide - Multilingual [EN | DE | FR | IT] - 192 pages (PDF)
- Highly-Detailed World Map with treasures and upgrades (PDF)
- Fan Artbook - 72 pages (PDF)
- 6 Wallpaper

and the Soundtrack with 75 minutes playtime and 27 tracks.
These new releases are also available in Bundles.
